author: (Jordan & Evermann, 1887)

note.en: A large oceanic pomfret that lives from the surface to about 600 m, with a stout body and dark colour; known here only from a regional record.
note.es: Una japuta oceánica grande que vive de la superficie a unos 600 m, de cuerpo robusto y color oscuro; aquí se conoce solo por un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; open-ocean or deep species, no local record.
